args.title: Support currency symbols such as ₹ and CHF in amount parsing
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Extend parseAmount to recognize and ignore currency signs besides €, $, £, and ¥, such as ₹ and CHF. This will allow amounts with these signs to be parsed correctly and avoid the 'The amount is not a number' error.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The failure comes from parseAmount in src/util/money.ts, which currently removes only €$£¥ signs before parsing. It needs to be extended to handle other currency symbols like ₹ and CHF so amounts are recognized as numbers, fixing imports from Indian and Swiss accounts.
